name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/obsidian-annotator
//: A hard fork of elias-sundqvist/obsidian-annotator (NOTICE.md). It keeps upstream's own npm and rollup setup and is left out of the repo's pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml), so its targets install with npm into its own node_modules. The Hypothesis client it builds is the submodule submodules/hypothesis-client-annotator-fork: `git submodule update --init` it before `build`.

install.//: Upstream's dependencies, with npm. Upstream ignores its lockfile, so this resolves afresh.

build.//: Upstream's `npm run build`: builds the Hypothesis client from the submodule into resources/, then bundles main.js.
